scope: Actual notebook training/export cells with bounded software fixtures; no model training, network or Drive writes.
checks: An interrupted resume can retry within the same runtime; completed rerun does not train twice.
An active identical call is rejected.
Interrupted transfer cannot initialize again through the training cell.
Compact export is CRC checked and atomically promoted; epoch weights are excluded.
A valid existing export is verified and reused unchanged.
An invalid existing export is rejected rather than downloaded.
